T: One night out. Nine months of snacks.
D: A slacker and a rising TV journalist find out a one-night stand has left them expecting a baby.
P: Serve the snacks when Ben and Alison find out.
S: Corn chips with chorizo, beans, cheddar, guacamole and sour cream

Corn chips layered with spiced refried beans, chorizo and cheddar, baked bubbling, then loaded with guacamole, sour cream and pickled jalapeño. Fry 2 diced chorizo until crisp. Warm 400g refried beans with 1 tsp cumin. Spread 300g corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and chorizo and cover with 200g grated cheddar. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime, salt and coriander. Top the nachos with guacamole, 150g sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.
Crispy chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, pickle ranch dip

Chicken bites soaked in dill pickle brine, fried crunchy and tossed in dill salt, with a pickle ranch dip and extra pickle chips on the side. Cut 600g chicken thigh into bite-sized pieces and soak in 250ml dill pickle brine for 2 hours. Drain, dip in 1 beaten egg with 100ml buttermilk, then 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and salt. Fry at 175C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt. Mix 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, 2 tbsp chopped pickles and dill for dipping.
M: Chicken in coconut green curry sauce served with jasmine rice

Chicken simmered in a fragrant green curry with coconut milk, Thai basil, snake beans and makrut lime, with jasmine rice and fresh chilli. Cook 1.5 cups jasmine rice. Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in 2 tbsp of the thick top of 400ml coconut milk until fragrant. Add 800g sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, 100ml stock, 4 torn makrut lime leaves, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tsp palm sugar. Simmer 12 minutes, adding 150g snake beans for the last 5. Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.
Roommates' pepperoni and hot honey pizza
Pepperoni, jalapeños and mozzarella on a crisp base, chilli honey and rocket on top

What Ben and the boys order every night of the week, made properly for once. Heat the oven as high as it goes with two trays inside. Mix 250g passata with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano and salt. Stretch 1kg pizza dough into 4 bases on baking paper, spread with the sauce and top with 300g mozzarella, 150g pepperoni and sliced jalapeños. Slide onto the hot trays and bake 8 to 10 minutes until blistered. Warm 2 tbsp honey with 1 tsp chilli flakes and drizzle over, then finish with rocket and shaved parmesan.
W: Lemon cupcakes with raspberry topping in pastel colours

Lemon butter cupcakes with a raspberry centre, piped with pale pink and blue buttercream and finished with freeze-dried raspberry crumbs. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar with lemon zest, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 cases for 18 minutes and cool. Fill each centre with raspberry jam (120g total). Beat 200g butter with 400g icing sugar and 2 tbsp milk, split in two and tint pale pink and pale blue. Pipe on and crumble over freeze-dried raspberries.
K: Grape juice, lime, soda water and mint over ice, no alcohol

Sparkling grape juice with lime and mint, a mocktail for the mum-to-be. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 150ml grape juice and a squeeze of lime to each and top with soda water and mint. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
